title: LiFi: LiDAR Generation from Multi-View Images via Geometric and Semantic Collaborative Guidance
title_zh: LiFi：通过几何与语义协同引导从多视角图像生成激光雷达数据

paragraphs.en: Generating LiDAR point clouds from multi-view camera images is a valuable task with applications in controllable data synthesis, cross-modal simulation and various perception tasks. However, most existing methods are not specifically designed for this task, and the quality of their generated LiDAR remains limited. Moreover, these methods typically focus only on semantic cues in images or generate LiDAR from a monocular camera image. In this work, we introduce LiFi ( Li DAR F rom i mages), a dedicated framework for generating visually and geometrically aligned LiDAR scenes from multi-view camera images. LiFi guides the latent diffusion process through two complementary branches: geometry and semantics. The geometry branch constructs scene features from images through a reverse sampling algorithm and an uncertainty-aware geometric encoder combined with DepthAnything3, whereas the semantic branch provides high-level semantic representations via a cross-view interaction module. We further introduce a dual-branch balanced classifier-free guidance (CFG) strategy, which enhances the model’s conditional generation capability while preserving the independent learning and collaborative controllability of the two branches. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiFi outperforms state-of-the-art methods in generating high-fidelity LiDAR scenes. The code will be publicly available at: https://github.com/szzhou88/LiFi.

paragraphs.en: The rapid progress of autonomous driving (AD) has drawn widespread attention [ 20 , 19 , 18 ] . LiDAR sensors, which provide precise 3D structural information, have become a cornerstone of modern AD systems [ 30 , 32 ] . Nevertheless, acquiring large-scale, high-quality LiDAR data could be expensive and the long-tail data captured by consumer devices might not employ LiDAR due to cost control of the product, limiting the robustness and scalability of data-driven methods. To mitigate this, pioneering LiDAR generation approaches [ 57 , 52 , 14 ] have been introduced, but they mainly focus on unconditional generation and suffer from limited realism because they fail to exploit the diverse contextual cues present in real-world scenes. Recently, conditional LiDAR point cloud generation [ 49 , 51 , 24 , 28 ] has emerged, leveraging inputs such as text, maps, and semantic layouts to achieve notable gains in both the photorealism and controllability of synthesized LiDAR scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 自动驾驶（AD）的快速发展已引起广泛关注 [ 20 , 19 , 18 ] 。 激光雷达传感器能够提供精确的三维结构信息，已成为现代自动驾驶系统的关键组成部分 [ 30 , 32 ] 。 然而，获取大规模、高质量的激光雷达数据可能成本高昂，而消费级设备采集的长尾数据由于产品成本控制可能并未使用激光雷达，这限制了数据驱动方法的鲁棒性和可扩展性。 为缓解这一问题，一些开创性的激光雷达生成方法 [ 57 , 52 , 14 ] 已被提出，但这些方法主要关注无条件生成，且因未能利用真实场景中多样的上下文线索而存在现实感不足的问题。 近期，条件式激光雷达点云生成技术 [ 49 , 51 , 24 , 28 ] 应运而生，它通过利用文本、地图和语义布局等输入，在合成激光雷达场景的拟真性和可控性方面取得了显著进步。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we study the conditional generation of LiDAR scenes from multi-view camera images. Cameras, owing to their low cost and ease of deployment, have become a standard sensor in modern autonomous systems. Generating LiDAR point clouds from such onboard multi-view images therefore holds broad application potential, where it can complement high-quality 3D perception under cost-sensitive sensor setups, and open up new possibilities for cross-modal simulation [ 11 ] , data augmentation [ 5 ] , and sensor completion [ 56 , 6 ] . However, this formulation remains relatively under-explored. A major challenge is the cross-modal gap between images and LiDAR. RGB images provide dense 2D appearance information, while LiDAR captures sparse yet precise 3D geometric measurements, making it difficult to establish accurate correspondences between the two heterogeneous representations. Furthermore, although multi-view cameras provide richer observations, different viewpoints also introduce variations in field of view, occlusion patterns, and semantic redundancy. As a result, existing methods [ 40 ] have only preliminarily explored images as conditioning inputs, focusing on semantic cues without explicitly enforcing geometric alignment between modalities, and are often limited to monocular inputs that lack comprehensive spatial awareness.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了如何根据多视角相机图像条件生成激光雷达场景。 由于成本较低且易于部署，相机已成为现代自动驾驶系统中的标准传感器。 因此，基于此类车载多视角图像生成激光雷达点云具有广泛的应用潜力：在注重成本的传感器配置中，它可以补充高质量的三维感知能力，并为跨模态模拟 [ 11 ]、数据增强 [ 5 ] 和传感器补全 [ 56 , 6 ] 开辟新的可能性。 然而，这一研究问题仍然相对未被充分探索。 一个主要挑战是图像与激光雷达之间的跨模态差异。 RGB 图像提供了密集的二维外观信息，而激光雷达则捕捉到稀疏但精确的三维几何测量值，这使得在两种异构表示之间建立准确的对应关系变得困难。 此外，尽管多视角相机能提供更丰富的观测信息，但不同视角也会带来视场、遮挡模式和语义冗余方面的差异。 因此，现有方法 [ 40 ] 仅初步探索了将图像作为条件输入，主要集中在语义线索上，而未明确强制不同模态之间的几何对齐，且通常局限于缺乏全面空间感知的单目输入。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we propose LiFi , a dedicated framework for generating high-fidelity LiDAR scenes from multi-view camera images. LiFi guides the latent diffusion process of LiDAR scenes, represented as range images, through two decoupled yet complementary branches: geometry and semantics. In the geometry branch, we first leverage DepthAnything3 [ 31 ] to estimate per-pixel depth and uncertainty maps from the input images. A range-view-centered reverse sampling algorithm then is designed to align these dense predictions, together with the original RGB images, to the LiDAR scanning pattern, producing depth, confidence, and appearance conditions. These conditions are subsequently encoded into structured geometric features via an uncertainty-modulated encoder that dynamically adjusts feature expressiveness based on local depth confidence. In the semantic branch, we extract high-level visual tokens and fuse them with patch, view, and camera extrinsic encodings. A cross-view attention module then aggregates global semantic context to capture long-range dependencies and cross-view consistency. Furthermore, we introduce a dual-branch balanced classifier-free guidance (CFG) strategy. By jointly training with full conditional, single-branch-conditional, and unconditional settings, this strategy not only enhances the model’s conditional guidance capability, but also improves the stability and effectiveness of collaborative learning between the two branches.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 LiFi——一个专门用于从多视角相机图像生成高保真激光雷达场景的框架。 LiFi 通过两个解耦但互补的分支（几何与语义）引导激光雷达场景的潜在扩散过程，这些场景以距离图像的形式表示。 在几何分支中，我们首先利用 DepthAnything3 [ 31 ] 从输入图像中估计每个像素的深度和不确定性图。 随后，我们设计了一种以距离视图为中心的反向采样算法，将这些密集预测与原始 RGB 图像对齐到激光雷达扫描模式，从而生成深度、置信度和外观条件。 这些条件随后通过一个不确定性调制编码器被编码为结构化几何特征，该编码器会根据局部深度置信度动态调整特征的表现力。 在语义分支中，我们提取高层视觉标记，并将其与图像块、视图和相机外参编码融合。 接着，一个跨视图注意力模块会聚合全局语义上下文，以捕捉长距离依赖关系和跨视图一致性。 此外，我们还引入了一种双分支平衡的无分类器引导（CFG）策略。 通过联合训练全条件、单分支条件和无条件设置，该策略不仅增强了模型的有条件引导能力，也提升了两个分支之间协同学习的稳定性和有效性。

paragraphs.en: We primarily compare LiFi with the state-of-the-art LiDAR generation models on the nuScenes dataset. We also compare it with existing frameworks capable of performing camera-to-LiDAR generation. To further evaluate the applicability of LiFi, we also compare it with several representative baseline methods on the KITTI-360 dataset [ 7 ] . Experimental results demonstrate the superior performance of our method in generating high-fidelity LiDAR scenes with geometric consistency and semantic alignment. Furthermore, we apply LiFi to a downstream object detection task. Although this does not directly demonstrate that LiFi-generated scenes can independently support perception performance comparable to that of real LiDAR data, it nevertheless provides evidence of the effectiveness of the proposed generation framework.
paragraphs.zh: 我们主要在 nuScenes 数据集上，将 LiFi 与当前最先进的激光雷达生成模型进行比较。 我们还将其与能够执行摄像头到激光雷达生成的现有框架进行了比较。 为了进一步评估 LiFi 的适用性，我们还在 KITTI-360 数据集 [7] 上将其与几种具有代表性的基线方法进行了比较。 实验结果表明，我们的方法在生成具有几何一致性和语义对齐的高保真激光雷达场景方面表现更优。 此外，我们将 LiFi 应用于一个下游的目标检测任务。 尽管这并未直接证明由 LiFi 生成的场景能够独立支持与真实激光雷达数据相当的性能，但它仍然为所提出的生成框架的有效性提供了证据。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We propose LiFi, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first dedicated framework capable of generating high-fidelity LiDAR scenes with geometric–visual alignment from multi-view images;
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 LiFi，据我们所知，这是首个能够从多视角图像中生成具有几何-视觉对齐的高保真激光雷达场景的专用框架；

paragraphs.en: We carefully design a range-view-centered reverse sampling algorithm, an uncertainty-aware geometric encoder, and a cross-view semantic encoder to achieve precise cross-modal alignment at the geometric level and effective global semantic guidance;

paragraphs.en: Generative Models. Generative models synthesize realistic and diverse new samples by learning the underlying data distribution. Early generative frameworks include GANs [ 8 ] and VAEs [ 22 ] . GANs can generate realistic images but suffer from issues such as training instability and mode collapse. VAEs provide an explicit probabilistic modeling formulation, but their generated results tend to be overly smooth. Autoregressive models [ 48 ] achieve accurate generation by progressively modeling conditional distributions, yet their sequential sampling process incurs high computational overhead. Diffusion models (DMs) [ 43 , 45 , 46 , 47 , 12 , 36 , 23 , 42 ] have demonstrated outstanding performance in image synthesis. Subsequent research has introduced latent diffusion models (LDMs) [ 41 ] , which perform the diffusion process in the latent space, thereby significantly improving generation efficiency. Meanwhile, they have also facilitated the advancement of conditional generation [ 35 , 39 , 53 ] .

paragraphs.en: LiDAR Scene Generation. LiDAR scene generation aims to synthesize 3D point cloud representations with realistic geometric structures and scanning patterns. Caccia et al. [ 1 ] were the first to adopt the range image representation and perform generation using VAEs and GANs. Subsequently, LiDARGen [ 57 ] proposed a score-based model for LiDAR generation. UltraLiDAR [ 52 ] voxelizes LiDAR point clouds and combines this representation with VQ-VAE for generation. R2DM [ 33 ] , built upon DDPMs, improves the fidelity of generated point clouds. RangeLDM [ 14 ] enables fast LiDAR data generation by performing diffusion in a compact latent space. DriveLiDAR4D [ 3 ] improves LiDAR generation quality by conditioning on three modalities: road sketches, scene descriptions, and object priors. UniScene [ 24 ] introduces occupancy as an intermediate representation, thereby reducing the difficulty of generating complex LiDAR scenes. OpenDWM [ 34 ] is built upon the DiT architecture for video generation and further extends it to LiDAR scenes. LiDARCrafter [ 28 ] parses natural language inputs into scene graphs to guide generation. LaGen [ 55 ] proposes an autoregressive framework for generating long-horizon LiDAR scenes.

paragraphs.en: Camera-to-LiDAR Generation. Camera-to-LiDAR generation refers to generating 3D LiDAR scenes from camera images. Unlike other conditional LiDAR generation models, research on directly synthesizing LiDAR data from camera images remains relatively limited. LiDM [ 40 ] proposes a multimodal conditional framework for LiDAR scene generation and also provides a preliminary exploration of the camera-to-LiDAR task by extracting semantic information from camera images. However, it does not investigate how to align the image and LiDAR modalities, which differ substantially from each other, and thus its generation quality remains limited. X-Drive [ 51 ] proposes a framework for the joint generation of LiDAR point clouds and multi-view camera images, taking both LiDAR point clouds and camera images as inputs and generating the two modalities simultaneously. It can be adapted to the camera-to-LiDAR task. However, its core framework is not specifically designed for the image-only input setting, and therefore does not exhibit clear performance advantages in this scenario. Moreover, it incorporates additional text prompts and 3D bounding box information to assist the generation process. Other frameworks for the joint generation of LiDAR point clouds and camera images include HoloDrive [ 50 ] and Genesis [ 10 ] , but they do not provide a camera-to-LiDAR mode. Our proposed method addresses the above challenges.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we describe the construction of the geometry-aware conditional branch in detail. This branch is designed to extract geometric features of the scene from multi-view camera observations, thereby providing explicit spatial structural constraints for the subsequent diffusion process. paragraphs.en: To fully exploit the estimated depth maps D D obtained from camera images, a straightforward approach is to project these depth maps pixel by pixel into LiDAR point clouds and then convert them into range images. However, this strategy fails to ensure accurate alignment between projected depth maps and LiDAR scenes, while also introducing substantial computational overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 为了充分利用从相机图像中获得的估计深度图 D，一种直接的方法是将这些深度图逐像素投影到激光雷达点云中，然后将其转换为距离图像。 然而，这种策略既无法确保投影后的深度图与激光雷达场景之间的精确对齐，还会带来巨大的计算开销。

sents.en: However, this strategy fails to ensure accurate alignment between projected depth maps and LiDAR scenes, while also introducing substantial computational overhead.

paragraphs.en: This issue arises because a single depth map contains millions of pixels (a common resolution is 1600 × 900 1600\times 900 ), whereas a typical LiDAR scene is inherently sparse. Direct projection is therefore not only inefficient, but also inconsistent with the distribution pattern of LiDAR data. To address this, we introduce a range-view-centered reverse depth sampling algorithm.

paragraphs.en: Dataset. We conduct experiments on the challenging nuScenes dataset [ 2 ] . It contains over a thousand autonomous driving sequences collected in two geographically distinct urban environments with complex traffic conditions. The nuScenes training set includes 297,737 LiDAR scans, while the test set contains 52,423 LiDAR scans, each captured by a 32-beam LiDAR sensor. This dataset is widely used in various autonomous driving tasks, such as 3D object detection [ 17 , 26 , 25 , 27 ] , multi-object tracking [ 13 , 38 , 54 ] , trajectory prediction [ 9 , 29 ] , and end-to-end autonomous driving [ 15 , 16 , 21 ] . We also conduct experiments on the KITTI-360 dataset [ 7 ] , as detailed in the supplementary material.

paragraphs.en: Implementation Details. We conduct distributed training on four NVIDIA H200 GPUs. Our model is trained for 200 epochs, with a total of 176,000 optimization steps, and the learning rate is set to 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . We use the DDIM sampler [ 44 ] for denoising, and set the total number of diffusion timesteps T T to 1024. The UNet consists of three downsampling blocks and three upsampling blocks, each containing two Transformer blocks. We employ DepthAnything3 [ 31 ] as the pretrained visual encoder, which can predict spatially consistent geometry from an arbitrary number of input views. It is an instantiation choice that matches the requirements, rather than an irreplaceable component of the framework. During inference, we perform 50 denoising steps to generate the target range image. More experimental settings and implementation details are provided in the supplementary material.
paragraphs.zh: 实现细节。 我们在四块 NVIDIA H200 GPU 上进行分布式训练。 我们的模型训练了 200 个周期，总共包含 176,000 次优化步骤，学习率设置为 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4}。 我们使用 DDIM 采样器 [ 44 ] 进行去噪，并将总扩散时间步数 T T 设为 1024。 UNet 包含三个下采样块和三个上采样块，每个块都包含两个 Transformer 块。 我们采用 DepthAnything3 [ 31 ] 作为预训练的视觉编码器，它可以从任意数量的输入视角中预测空间一致的几何结构。 这是一个满足需求的具体实现选择，而非框架中不可替代的组件。 在推理阶段，我们执行 50 次去噪步骤以生成目标范围图像。 更多实验设置和实现细节见补充材料。

paragraphs.en: We propose LiFi, a dedicated framework for generating realistic LiDAR scenes from multi-view camera images. We introduce a dual-branch conditioning strategy to guide the latent diffusion process, effectively addressing the challenges of cross-modal geometric alignment and cross-view semantic aggregation. Experimental results show that LiFi is capable of generating high-fidelity LiDAR scenes. Moreover, the LiDAR point cloud generated by it has certain value for some downstream tasks of autonomous driving. In the future, we expect LiFi to play an important role in applications such as simulation, planning, and control in various complex environments and long-tail scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 LiFi，一个专门用于从多视角相机图像生成逼真激光雷达场景的框架。 我们引入了一种双分支条件策略来引导潜在扩散过程，有效解决了跨模态几何对齐和跨视角语义聚合的挑战。 实验结果表明，LiFi 能够生成高保真的激光雷达场景。 此外，由其生成的激光雷达点云在某些自动驾驶下游任务中具有一定的价值。 未来，我们期望 LiFi 能够在各种复杂环境和长尾场景下的模拟、规划与控制等应用中发挥重要作用。

paragraphs.en: Our work presents several limitations. Primarily, relying on the range image representation is not entirely lossless, resulting in the omission of certain camera image details within the synthesized LiDAR point clouds. Refining this representation in future research holds the potential to further boost model performance. Furthermore, the overall architecture of our method is not specifically designed for explicit temporal modeling. Although this work does not focus on generating temporal LiDAR sequences, incorporating temporal consistency mechanisms in future work could extend the applicability of our method to a broader range of scenarios.

paragraphs.en: In the geometry-aware branch, the encoder primarily consists of multiple convolutional layers, normalization layers, downsampling layers, zero-convolution layers, and FiLM modules. In the cross-view semantic branch, the encoder mainly includes a multi-head self-attention layer, a feed-forward network (composed of two fully connected layers), and two Layer Normalization layers. paragraphs.en: Range images offer a compact representation of LiDAR data by parametrizing unstructured point clouds in 3D space into a 2D pixel space. paragraphs.en: Replaceability of the Pretrained Vision Model.
paragraphs.zh: 预训练视觉模型的可替换性。

paragraphs.en: From the perspective of the framework interface, LiFi does not depend on the specific internal architecture of DepthAnything3. The geometric branch only requires the depth foundation model to provide two types of per-pixel information for each input view: depth predictions and their corresponding reliability estimates. LiFi’s reverse sampling module then aligns these predictions with the target LiDAR scanning grid, while the uncertainty-aware encoder uses the reliability signals to modulate the geometric features. Therefore, as long as an alternative model can provide outputs in the same form, the subsequent inverse sampling, FiLM modulation, and diffusion generation pipeline can remain unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 从框架接口的角度来看，LiFi 并不依赖 DepthAnything3 的具体内部架构。 几何分支仅需深度基础模型为每个输入视图提供两种每像素信息：深度预测及其对应的可靠性估计。 随后，LiFi 的反向采样模块将这些预测与目标 LiDAR 扫描网格对齐，同时不确定性感知编码器利用可靠性信号来调制几何特征。 因此，只要替代模型能够提供相同形式的输出，后续的反向采样、FiLM 调制和扩散生成流程就可以保持不变。

paragraphs.en: We first emphasize that the final LiDAR generated by LiFi is already represented in the metric LiDAR coordinate system of the target dataset, rather than having only relative scale.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先强调，LiFi 生成的最终激光雷达数据已经表示为目标数据集的公制激光雷达坐标系中的形式，而不仅仅是具有相对比例。

paragraphs.en: LiFi trains the diffusion model with range images constructed from real LiDAR scans as the target, and therefore learns a mapping from relative visual geometry and image semantics to real metric LiDAR distance distributions. After de-normalization, each valid cell in the generated range image represents an actual distance in the target sensor coordinate system. It can then be back-projected using the corresponding laser-beam elevation angles, azimuth sampling, and sensor calibration parameters to obtain a 3D point cloud in meters. The range image transformation adopted in the paper is itself reversible, and the generation target is constructed from the metric distances of real LiDAR scans.
paragraphs.zh: LiFi 使用由真实激光雷达扫描数据构建的距离图像作为目标来训练扩散模型，因此能够学习从相对视觉几何和图像语义到真实度量激光雷达距离分布的映射关系。 经过反归一化处理后，生成的距离图像中每个有效的单元格都代表目标传感器坐标系中的一个实际距离。 随后，可以利用相应的激光束仰角、方位角采样以及传感器校准参数对其进行反向投影，从而获得以米为单位的三维点云。 论文中采用的距离图像变换本身是可逆的，且其生成目标由真实激光雷达扫描数据的度量距离构建而成。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, for datasets such as nuScenes and KITTI-360, there is no need to fit an additional global scale factor after generation. Metric LiDAR point clouds from datasets such as KITTI and Argoverse can likewise be directly converted into range images according to the scanning pattern of the target sensor and used as training supervision for LiFi.

paragraphs.en: If LiFi is to be adapted to a specific simulator, we recommend the following procedure:
paragraphs.zh: 如果要将 LiFi 适配到特定的模拟器中，我们建议遵循以下流程：

paragraphs.en: 1. If the simulator is intended to use a target LiDAR configuration consistent with those of current mainstream datasets, the LiFi architecture trained on these datasets can be directly used.
paragraphs.zh: 1. 如果模拟器打算使用与当前主流数据集一致的激光雷达目标配置，那么在这些数据集上训练的 LiFi 架构可以直接使用。

sents.en: If the simulator is intended to use a target LiDAR configuration consistent with those of current mainstream datasets, the LiFi architecture trained on these datasets can be directly used.
sents.zh: 如果模拟器打算使用与当前主流数据集一致的激光雷达目标配置，那么在这些数据集上训练的 LiFi 架构可以直接使用。

paragraphs.en: 2. If the goal is to simulate a completely new virtual target LiDAR configuration, the first step is to specify the target LiDAR settings, including the beam elevation angles, horizontal angular resolution, and extrinsic parameters. Based on these settings, the target range image representation can then be constructed, and the VAE and diffusion model can be trained or fine-tuned using camera–metric LiDAR data corresponding to that sensor. At inference time, the generated results can be converted back into a metric point cloud according to the same normalization parameters and sensor model.
paragraphs.zh: 2. 如果目标是模拟一个全新的虚拟目标激光雷达配置，第一步是明确目标激光雷达的设置，包括光束仰角、水平角度分辨率和外部参数。 基于这些设置，接下来可以构建目标距离图像表示，并使用与该传感器对应的相机-度量激光雷达数据训练或微调 VAE 和扩散模型。 在推理阶段，生成的结果可以根据相同的归一化参数和传感器模型转换回度量点云。
